failures.description: Complex API reference with multiple violations
failures.input: The authenticateUser function handles user authentication and authorization. It takes a credentials object which contains the username and password, performs validation, and returns a JWT token that can be utilized for subsequent requests. Make sure to call this function before accessing any protected endpoints.
failures.output: Here is the corrected text followed by the compliance summary.
failures.compliance_summary:
| # | Original | Correction | Principle(s) | Reason |
|---|----------|------------|--------------|--------|
| 1 | handles | does | P3, P12 | "Handle" in STE means to touch/operate with hands, not to process. "Do" is the approved synonym for perform/execute. |
| 2 | performs validation | checks | P1, Synonym table | "Perform" maps to "do"; "validation" maps to "check." Restructured as a direct verb for clarity and brevity. |
| 3 | utilized | used | Synonym table | "Utilize" is not approved; "use" is the canonical synonym. |
| 4 | subsequent | later | P1, P3 | "Subsequent" is not in the STE-Code dictionary. "Later" is a simpler, approved alternative. |
| 5 | Make sure to | (removed) | P1, Output format | "Make sure" is phrasal/jargon. Replaced with direct imperative mood as required by procedural output format. |
| 6 | accessing | access | P4, Anti-patterns | "-ing" forms must not be used as main verbs in procedures. |
| 7 | takes | gets | Synonym table | "Get" is the preferred synonym over retrieve/fetch/obtain for obtaining data. |
| 8 | contains | has | P9 | "Has" is shorter and simpler per the preference for short, clear terms. |
